AUTHOR: Allken
TITLE: A deep learning-based method to identify and count pelagic and mesopelagic fishes from trawl camera images
SPECIES: Blue whiting, Atlantic herring, Atlantic mackerel, mesopelagic fishes (Mueller's pearlside + glacier lanternfish grouped)
DATA: Deep Vision in-trawl image dataset (Allken et al. 2021; 2017 and 2018 cruises), 1879 annotated real images + 20000 synthetic images; catch data from 20 trawl stations (2018)
V_EV: Image data: 'Cameras and lighting were upgraded between the 2017 and 2018 cruises, resulting in sharper but slightly lower final resolution images for the 2018 data'
D2: D1 (343 imgs) train source; D2 train/val; D3 test (918 imgs); split files from published dataset
D_EV: Annotated datasets: 'D2 and D3 refers to the val_annotations.csv and test_annotations.csv data sets, respectively.' (split unit not described)
R_EV: Results: 'Each trained model was then evaluated on the same test set, D3 of 918 images' (real images from the same Deep Vision dataset)
C_EV: Optimal score threshold: 'evaluate precision, recall and F1 score for score thresholds ranging from 0.05 to 1'; Discussion: 'Instead of tracking we have modelled the relationship between the Deep Vision counts and the catch data'
E_EV: Methods: 'The sum of predicted fish counts by species was compared with the catch data for each trawl haul.'; multiple linear regression vs catch
ARCH: RetinaNet (Keras, FPN, focal loss) + auxiliary empty/fish/krill image classifier
METR: mAP@0.5, precision/recall/F1 vs threshold, confusion matrix, count error, log-log regression vs catch
NOTE: Split: D2/D3 are predefined split files of the authors' published Deep Vision dataset; unit of split (station/image) not described in this paper; images taken every 200 ms so near-duplicate frames possible but not discussed. D1 coded 사전 정의 공개 split 사용; D_ALL rule has no branch for a predefined split whose content is not stated -> coded NR (low-information choice); verifier check. C5 coded 중복계수 처리 because repeated imaging of the same fish is explicitly modelled via regression on catch (and no_class_specific_filter avoids duplicate per-class boxes); if verifier judges this not explicit handling, C_ALL would be P (threshold sweep). E5: trawl catch = independent reference listed in instructions. ENV pelagic/mesopelagic open ocean has no matching category -> NR. FNR: missed rates per species (e.g. herring 22%, mesopelagic 11%). V2 depth of encounters (70-100 m, >250 m) reported; V3 artificial lighting/upgrade. CODE = synthetic data generation code available; detector uses public Keras RetinaNet.
